courses.title: Advance Mobile Hardware & Software Course (Basic to Advance)
courses.shortDescription: Learn schematic diagrams, chip-level repair, IC reballing, eMMC/eMCP repairing, 4G/5G network troubleshooting and boot-related problems.
courses.fullOverview: The flagship Advance Mobile Hardware & Software Course at MOBNET International is structured for beginners, intermediate repairers, and shop owners who wish to master modern smartphone technology. Starting with foundational electronics and multimeter diagnostics, the curriculum advances into microscopic circuit tracing with Borneo Schematics, BGA IC removal and reballing, power-rail short clearance, and complete Android/iOS software flashing.
highlights: Basic to advanced multi-layer motherboard tracing
SMD component testing, soldering, and micro-jumpers
Borneo Schematics & ZXW bitmap schematic reading
Complete software flashing, EDL 9008, and FRP unlocking
Free demo classes before admission
Lifetime backup support (online and offline)
modules: Basic Electronics: Resistors, Capacitors, Coils, Diodes & Transistors
Multimeter Diagnostics (Cold testing, Hot voltage testing & Diode value check)
DC Power Supply current tracking and short circuit identification
SMD Hot Air Rework station profiling and BGA IC reballing
Power IC (PMIC), Charging IC, Audio IC & Backlight circuit fixing
Double-decker CPU & RAM separation and reballing techniques
eMMC / eMCP storage chip programming and dead boot recovery
Android & iOS flashing, unlocking, FRP bypass, and baseband troubleshooting
skillsLearned: Reading and tracing smartphone circuit schematics and line impedance
Diagnosing dead phones via DC power supply boot current draw (0-20mA, 50-100mA, 200mA)
Removing and reballing microscopic BGA chips without overheating the logic board
0.02mm insulated copper wire micro-jumpering under the microscope
Flashing official firmware using Fastboot, EDL 9008, and recovery modes
Unlocking Google FRP, screen passcodes, and restoring corrupt baseband
courses.practicalApproach: Every student receives an individual bench equipped with a trinocular microscope and rework tools. You practice on live faulty Android and iPhone motherboards, diagnosing real hardware faults, locating shorted capacitors, and repairing broken tracks.
careerOpportunities: Establish your own independent mobile repair & service centre
Senior chip-level hardware technician at multi-brand service centers
Motherboard repair partner for regional smartphone retail shops

faqs.question: What is the confirmed duration of this course?
faqs.answer: The Advance Mobile Hardware & Software Course has a confirmed duration of 2 months.

faqs.question: Do I need prior electronics experience to enroll?
faqs.answer: No. The curriculum is built from basic electronics up to advance chip-level repair. Beginners are guided step-by-step.

faqs.question: Are demo classes available before enrollment?
faqs.answer: Yes, MOBNET International provides free demo classes so you can experience our lab equipment and teaching style.

faqs.question: What kind of support is provided after the course?
faqs.answer: All enrolled students receive lifetime online and offline backup support from our faculty whenever they encounter difficult faults in their shops.

faqs.question: How can I enquire about the fee structure?
faqs.answer: Course fees and installment options are transparently shared during in-person campus counseling or directly via our admissions WhatsApp line (96616 11350) to match your batch choice.

courses.title: Basic Mobile Repairing Course
courses.shortDescription: Learn mobile hardware fundamentals, repair tools, safe disassembly and common display, charging, battery and speaker faults.
courses.fullOverview: The Basic Mobile Repairing Course provides an accessible entry point for students desiring essential mobile repair capabilities. You will learn proper tool safety, heat pad disassembly for various smartphone frames, precision soldering of charging ports (Type-C and Micro-USB), microphone replacements, and touchscreen combo testing.
highlights: Safe smartphone disassembly without damaging internal flex cables
Charging sub-board, Type-C, and micro-USB port soldering
Combo display, touch glass, and battery replacements
Multimeter continuity testing and battery boost activation
Free demo classes prior to admission
modules: Smartphone Architecture & Mechanical Frame Types
Repair Tools: screwdrivers, suction cups, pry picks, heating mats
Soldering Iron Usage: replacing mics, vibrators, and charging ports
Display Replacement: OLED, AMOLED, and IPS LCD testing & installation
Battery Health Checking, manual boosting, and connector repair
Audio Sections: diagnosing earpiece, loudspeaker, and microphone issues
toolsCovered: Precision Screwdriver Kit (Torx, Pentalobe, Phillips, Tri-Point)
skillsLearned: Disassembling and assembling popular Android brands safely
Desoldering damaged charging ports and soldering clean new connectors
Testing and installing combo screens with clean adhesive application
Using digital multimeters for voltage and continuity checks
Replacing damaged cameras, fingerprint sensors, and antenna flexes
courses.practicalApproach: Direct hands-on bench practice opening handsets, replacing worn connectors, testing replacement screens, and using soldering irons safely.
careerOpportunities: Smartphone screen and battery replacement specialist
Entry-level repair technician at retail electronics stores

faqs.question: Is this course suitable for complete beginners?
faqs.answer: Yes, this course requires no prior technical experience and focuses on foundational assembly and common component repairs.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade to the Advance Course later?
faqs.answer: Yes, students completing the basic course can transition seamlessly into the Chip-Level or Advance programs.

faqs.question: Are demo sessions available?
faqs.answer: Yes, free demo sessions are available at our Bank More, Dhanbad lab before admission.

courses.title: Mobile Chip-Level Repairing Course
courses.shortDescription: Study schematic reading, shorting and power-section fault finding, IC reballing and black-pasted IC repair.
courses.fullOverview: The Mobile Chip-Level Repairing Course is designed for technicians who want to elevate their capabilities from simple module swaps to intricate motherboard surgery. You will master reading multi-layer schematics, finding secondary leakage lines using thermal detection, clearing full and half shorts, removing black-glued/underfill ICs, and precision BGA reballing.
highlights: Trinocular stereo microscope micro-soldering (0.02mm jumpers)
BGA IC glue cleaning, stencil paste alignment, and reballing
Full short, half short, and secondary voltage leakage detection
Schematic bitmap reading with Borneo Schematics and ZXW
Lifetime backup support (online and offline)
modules: Multilayer PCB layer tracing and line impedance measuring
Power Sequence: VPH_PWR, PMIC output rails, Reset, and Clock
Underfill black glue & white glue IC extraction techniques
Double-decker CPU & RAM separation and reballing
Thermal imaging and short killer voltage injection
RF section, WTR transceiver, and Audio Codec fault diagnosis
toolsCovered: C210 Micro-soldering Station with ultra-fine tips
BGA Reballing Stencils for Qualcomm, MTK, Exynos
skillsLearned: Diagnosing short circuits without damaging surrounding sensitive chips
Safely softening and scraping tough epoxy/black glue from IC edges
Reballing BGA micro-ICs with uniform solder ball height
Jumpering damaged PCB copper pads under 45X optical magnification
Tracing I2C, SPI, and SPMI bus voltage lines systematically
courses.practicalApproach: Dedicated microscope bench time working on real dead motherboards, tracking power lines, and replacing complex BGA ICs.
careerOpportunities: Subcontract repairer handling difficult board jobs for other retail shops

faqs.question: What level of soldering skill is required?
faqs.answer: Familiarity with basic soldering is helpful, but our instructors train you from fundamental micro-soldering up to BGA reballing.

faqs.question: Do we practice on actual motherboards?
faqs.answer: Yes, 90% of class time is spent working directly on live smartphone logic boards under microscopes.

faqs.question: How do I enquire about batch dates and fees?
faqs.answer: Please contact the institute directly at 96616 11350 or via WhatsApp for upcoming batch schedules and fee details.

courses.title: Laptop Repairing Course
courses.shortDescription: Learn laptop hardware fundamentals, motherboard fault finding and common display, keyboard and charging problems.
courses.fullOverview: The Laptop Repairing Course trains you on modern laptop logic boards, common rail 19V short finding, 3.3V/5V standby power section diagnosis, BIOS flash chip reprogramming, display flex repair, keyboard swapping, and thermal cooling overhaul.
highlights: Laptop schematic and boardview reading
19V DC jack to charging IC power rail tracing
Standby controller (3.3V / 5V) section debugging
BIOS chip reading, writing, and clean ME region programming
Free demo classes available
modules: Laptop Motherboard Architecture & Major Component Identification
Power Sequence from DC Jack through MOSFETs to PCH/CPU
Testing MOSFETs, Gate voltages, and current sensing resistors
Screen replacements: 30-pin, 40-pin eDP, OLED, and hinge repairs
BIOS Flash Programming with CH341A / RT809F programmers
Overheating issues: fan cleaning, heat pipe testing, thermal paste
toolsCovered: Variable Voltage DC Laptop Power Supply with universal jack tips
skillsLearned: Tracing laptop motherboard schematics with boardview software
Finding 19V shorted ceramic capacitors using DC power supplies
Programming SPI flash BIOS chips and repairing corrupted firmware
Diagnosing charging faults and replacing charging ICs
Replacing broken laptop hinges, touchpads, and keyboards

careerOpportunities: Independent computer & laptop service business owner

faqs.question: Are brand-specific schematics covered?
faqs.answer: Yes, we teach schematic and boardview reading applicable across major brands including Dell, HP, Lenovo, and Asus.

faqs.question: Do we learn BIOS programming?
faqs.answer: Yes, you learn how to desolder, read, write, and verify BIOS chips using hardware programmers.

SMPS pinout voltage checking and power supply testing
Diagnosing POST beep codes and blue screen (BSOD) hardware faults

Basic LAN networking, crimping RJ45 connectors, and router setup

Resolving RAM compatibility, CMOS battery, and BIOS boot order issues
Installing Windows and essential hardware drivers cleanly
Crimping Ethernet cables and setting up local network file sharing

faqs.question: Is software installation included in this course?
